# Majeed syndrome papers to find by hand (2026-11-15)

*Generated by `analysis/corpus/majeed_papers_to_find.py` from `data/literature/majeed/`. These papers passed title/abstract screening, but no open full text was found through Europe PMC, PMC or Unpaywall. The same list with columns to fill in is `reports/majeed_papers_to_find_2026-11-15.csv`.*

**61 PubMed papers** (A 15, B 10, C 36) and **27 records outside PubMed** (part 2). "Free copy listed" means Europe PMC lists a free or open copy outside PMC that the pipeline did not fetch; try those first.

Save what you find as `<PMID>.pdf` (or a short title for part 2) and tell Claude where it is. PDFs anywhere under `data/literature/` are git-ignored, so they are not published with the repository. Under D-32 (open access only) and D-47 (free copies until 2026-11-30, for the six diseases), a subscription copy is a separate decision.
